IntroducedBillHeader.Sponsors: Representatives Kretz, Holmquist, Haler, Buri, Newhouse and Orcutt

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to providing assistance to small counties andcities facing legal liability and costs associated with an action filedunder the federal clean water act's citizen suit provision; and addinga new section to chapter 90.48 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.48 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) A county or city with a population fewer than fifteen thousandthat receives a notice pursuant to 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365(b) may receiveassistance from the department in responding to a notice filed pursuantto 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365(b) and defending against an action filedpursuant to 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365. The department shall provide, withoutcharge to the county or city submitting a request under this section,any or all of the following assistance: (a) Educational information related to the requirements of thefederal clean water act, 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365; (b) Educational and technical information regarding measures toachieve compliance with the requirements of the federal clean wateract, 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365; p. 1 HB 1925 (c) Review of the county's or city's activities and programsassociated with the allegations in the notice filed pursuant to 33U.S.C. Sec. 1365(b) to determine potential compliance issues and toidentify measures to achieve compliance; and (d) Technical assistance, research, or other assistance andinformation related to responding to the notice filed pursuant to 33U.S.C. Sec. 1365(b) and defending against an action filed pursuant to33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365. (2) A county or city with a population fewer than fifteen thousandthat receives a notice pursuant to 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365(b) may receivelegal defense assistance from the attorney general in responding to anotice filed pursuant to 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365(b) and defending againstan action filed pursuant to 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365. The attorney generalshall provide, without charge to the county or city submitting arequest under this section, any or all of the following assistance: (a) Legal review of the notice filed pursuant to 33 U.S.C. Sec.1365(b), with analysis of the allegations in the notice and apreliminary analysis of the relative merits of those allegations; (b) Legal research and drafting assistance; and (c) Legal representation and defense in responding to the noticefiled pursuant to 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365(b) and defending against anaction filed pursuant to 33 U.S.C. Sec. 1365. (3) The department and the office of the attorney general shallrespond promptly to any requests for assistance submitted according tosubsection (1) or (2) of this section.
